integrity: Structural proof given for all part profiles; exact finite brute-force tests are independent checks, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected chain graphs; the 2025/2026 general P6-free counting algorithm is prior work and covers countability. The motivating 2026 manuscript was accessible only in abstract; a complete full-text overlap exclusion was not possible. Exhaustive checks finite.
title: All perfect edge dominating sets of nontrivial connected chain graphs
